# Gilbert Ryle

*1900 – 1976 · British · [Ordinary language philosophy](../movements/ordinary-language-philosophy.md)*

British philosopher at Oxford: in The Concept of Mind (1949), he denounced the Cartesian « ghost in the machine » as a category mistake and proposed an analysis of mind in terms of dispositions.
